description: The phone file picker fills the content width and height beneath its 48px toolbar, scrolls, and dismisses without closing the viewer. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". Click the row with title "change-01.txt" in ".diff-rethink-mobile-files". The file position reads "File 1 of 35"; the bottom ".diff-rethink-bottom-change-label" reads "Change 1 of 1" without a file count. The ".diff-rethink-file-jump" spans the phone width with 8px side gutters (compare its bounding box with innerWidth). Click it. The dialog named "Choose file" is visible. Compare its getBoundingClientRect() with ".diff-viewer-content": left and right edges coincide, its top is 48px below content top and its bottom coincides with content bottom (round differences; eval expecting true). Its ".diff-tree-scroll" has scrollHeight greater than clientHeight. Scroll the row titled "change-35.txt" into view and click it. The file name is "change-35.txt", the position is "File 35 of 35", and the dialog is hidden. Open the picker again, resize viewport to 390x500, and repeat the edge and 48px geometry assertion. Press Escape: picker hidden, overlay still visible. Open picker again, click its button named exactly "Close": picker hidden and overlay visible.

steps.expression: (() => { const btn = document.querySelector('.diff-rethink-file-jump'); const r = btn.getBoundingClientRect(); const iw = window.innerWidth; return Math.abs(r.left - 8) <= 1 && Math.abs(iw - r.right - 8) <= 1; })()

(() => { const dialog = document.querySelector('.diff-rethink-mobile-files'); const content = document.querySelector('.diff-viewer-content'); const dr = dialog.getBoundingClientRect(); const cr = content.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(dr.left) === Math.round(cr.left) && Math.round(dr.right) === Math.round(cr.right) && Math.round(dr.top - cr.top) === 48 && Math.round(dr.bottom) === Math.round(cr.bottom); })()
